game.title: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle

roadmap.title: Finish the base story and regional side content
roadmap.description: Play every base-game region on any difficulty, completing nearby Fieldwork and easy situational achievements while collecting notes, books, relics, and local food.

roadmap.title: Clean up the base-game hubs
roadmap.description: Use Journal maps and Revisit to finish mysteries, collectibles, boxing rings, Adventure Books, combat actions, all 50 Ancient Relics, and every base-game Journal entry.

roadmap.title: Complete The Order of Giants
roadmap.description: Start the DLC beside the Vatican’s Fountain of Confession, follow its story into Rome, and collect visible notes and artifacts along the route.

roadmap.title: Clean up Rome
roadmap.description: Use fast travel and the Rome Guide to finish all 118 Journal entries, seven Mithraic Artifacts, three mysteries, both Adventure Book abilities, and the Via Giulia cat.

achievements.sortReason: Unlocks automatically during the main story.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{The Golden Idol} story mission in @loc{the opening temple}.

guide.context: This is the opening tutorial in the fixed main-story sequence and unlocks automatically at the mission ending. No difficulty setting is required.

steps.text: Advance the main story until @mechanic{The Golden Idol} becomes the active mission in @loc{the opening temple}.
Complete every objective in @mechanic{The Golden Idol} and finish its closing scene to trigger the achievement.

achievements.sortReason: Unlocks automatically during the main story.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{The Break-In} story mission in @loc{Marshall College}.

guide.context: This is the second story mission in the fixed main-story sequence and unlocks automatically at the mission ending. No difficulty setting is required.

steps.text: Advance the main story until @mechanic{The Break-In} becomes the active mission in @loc{Marshall College}.
Complete every objective in @mechanic{The Break-In} and finish its closing scene to trigger the achievement.

achievements.sortReason: Unlocks automatically during the main story.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{The Stolen Cat Mummy} story mission in @loc{the Vatican}.

guide.context: This is the Vatican story mission in the fixed main-story sequence and unlocks automatically at the mission ending. No difficulty setting is required.

steps.text: Advance the main story until @mechanic{The Stolen Cat Mummy} becomes the active mission in @loc{the Vatican}.
Complete every objective in @mechanic{The Stolen Cat Mummy} and finish its closing scene to trigger the achievement.

achievements.sortReason: Unlocks automatically during the main story.

guide.context: This is the Gizeh story mission in the fixed main-story sequence and unlocks automatically at the mission ending. No difficulty setting is required.

steps.text: Advance the main story until @mechanic{The Idol of Ra} becomes the active mission in @loc{Gizeh}.
Complete every objective in @mechanic{The Idol of Ra} and finish its closing scene to trigger the achievement.

achievements.sortReason: Unlocks automatically during the main story.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{A Harsh Climb} story mission in @loc{the Himalayas}.

guide.context: This is the Himalayas story mission in the fixed main-story sequence and unlocks automatically at the mission ending. No difficulty setting is required.

steps.text: Advance the main story until @mechanic{A Harsh Climb} becomes the active mission in @loc{the Himalayas}.
Complete every objective in @mechanic{A Harsh Climb} and finish its closing scene to trigger the achievement.

achievements.sortReason: Unlocks automatically during the main story.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Into the Fire} story mission in @loc{Shanghai}.

guide.context: This is the Shanghai story mission in the fixed main-story sequence and unlocks automatically at the mission ending. No difficulty setting is required.

steps.text: Advance the main story until @mechanic{Into the Fire} becomes the active mission in @loc{Shanghai}.
Complete every objective in @mechanic{Into the Fire} and finish its closing scene to trigger the achievement.

achievements.sortReason: Unlocks automatically during the main story.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{The Blessed Pearl} story mission in @loc{Sukhothai}.

steps.text: Advance the main story until @mechanic{The Blessed Pearl} becomes the active mission in @loc{Sukhothai}.
Complete every objective in @mechanic{The Blessed Pearl} and finish its closing scene to trigger the achievement.

steps.text: Advance the main story until @mechanic{Atonements} becomes the active mission in @loc{Iraq}.
Complete every objective in @mechanic{Atonements} and finish its closing scene to trigger the achievement.

achievements.description: Bring all radio frequencies to Gina.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Collect four radio frequencies in @loc{Gizeh} and four in @loc{Sukhothai}, then deliver both sets to @npc{Gina}.

guide.context: The eight frequencies are found inside enemy compounds. A regional set can be handed over only while Gina is beside a boat-call radio.

steps.text: Search the Nazi compounds in @loc{Gizeh} and collect all @item{four Gizeh radio frequencies}.
Stand beside a boat-call radio while @npc{Gina} is present and give her the complete Gizeh set.
Search the Fascist compounds in @loc{Sukhothai} and collect all @item{four Sukhothai radio frequencies}.
Meet @npc{Gina} beside a Sukhothai boat-call radio and deliver the complete Sukhothai set.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Return all @item{15 Lost Artifacts}: five from the Vatican, five from Gizeh, and five from Sukhothai.

guide.context: Each hub uses separate currency. Buying the local Lost Artifact guide book adds that region’s remaining artifact locations to the map.

steps.text: Buy the Lost Artifact guide in @loc{the Vatican}, collect its five marked artifacts, and return the complete set.
Buy the Lost Artifact guide in @loc{Gizeh}, collect its five marked artifacts, and return the complete set.
Buy the Lost Artifact guide in @loc{Sukhothai}, collect its five marked artifacts, and return the complete set.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Buy the camera from @npc{Ernesto} in the Vatican Post Office and photograph Ernesto behind his counter.

guide.context: The camera purchase is a required objective during The Stolen Cat Mummy, so the photo can be taken immediately after the camera tutorial.

steps.text: During @mechanic{The Stolen Cat Mummy}, enter the @loc{Vatican Post Office} and buy the camera from @npc{Ernesto}.
Equip the camera, aim it at Ernesto behind the counter, wait for the subject frame to register, and take the photograph.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Learn ten abilities by buying ten @item{Adventure Book} upgrades with Adventure Points in the Books menu.

guide.context: Adventure Points come from missions and Journal discoveries. Books can be found, bought from regional vendors, traded for medicine, or earned through boxing rings.

steps.text: Acquire at least ten different @item{Adventure Books} while exploring and completing regional activities.
Open the inventory’s @mechanic{Books} section and spend Adventure Points until ten listed abilities show as learned.

achievements.description: Learn an ability from an Adventure book.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Learn one ability by finding an @item{Adventure Book} and buying its ability with Adventure Points in the Books menu.

guide.context: Picking up an Adventure Book only adds it to the inventory; the achievement checks the separate ability purchase.

steps.text: Find or buy any @item{Adventure Book}.
Open the inventory’s @mechanic{Books} section, select the new book, and spend its listed Adventure Point cost to learn the ability.

achievements.description: Learn all abilities from Adventure books.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Learn all @item{55 base-game Adventure Book abilities} by finding every book and purchasing every listed upgrade.

guide.context: Doctor inventories are shared across the three hubs, but each underground boxing ring has unique book rewards. Regional currencies cannot be transferred between hubs, so finish each vendor before leaving its region.

steps.text: In the Vatican, Gizeh, and Sukhothai, buy the local @item{Books guide} from the regional vendor and clear every Adventure Book marker that the guide adds to that region’s map.
Inspect every regional store inventory and buy each listed Adventure Book; trade medicine for every doctor book and collect the unique book rewards from all three underground boxing rings.
Earn Adventure Points from missions, photographs, and discoveries, then buy every ability in the @mechanic{Books} menu until all 55 are learned.

achievements.description: Photograph all Inscriptions in Vatican City and return to Antonio.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Photograph all @item{10 Vatican inscriptions}, return to @npc{Antonio}, and place every photograph on his board.

guide.context: The Secret of Giants marks inscription search zones after enough Vatican story progress. The achievement requires the return step, not only the ten photographs.

steps.text: Progress @mechanic{The Secret of Giants} until all ten inscription search zones appear on the Vatican map.
Visit every search zone and photograph the inscription when the camera frame confirms the subject.
Return to @npc{Antonio} and place all ten inscription photographs on the board in his office.

achievements.description: Solve all mysteries in Vatican City.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Complete all @item{eight Vatican mysteries}, from Bulls of Blood through Signs of Trouble.

guide.context: Mysteries are Journal investigations rather than Fieldwork missions. All remain available through the Vatican Revisit map.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{Bulls of Blood} and @mechanic{A Date to Remember}; then close the Vatican cases @mechanic{Secret of Secrets} and @mechanic{House of God}.
Resolve @mechanic{A Free Spirit} and @mechanic{A Snake in the Garden}; then finish @mechanic{Father and Son} plus @mechanic{Signs of Trouble}.
Open the Vatican Journal page and confirm that all eight Mystery entries are complete.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Recover all @item{10 missing Stelae} in @loc{Gizeh}, including the six beyond Gina’s initial request.

guide.context: The first objective asks for only four Stelae. Several of the remaining six sites cannot be cleared until Indy has the lighter.

steps.text: Begin the missing-Stelae assignment in @loc{Gizeh} and recover the first four pieces requested by @npc{Gina}.
After obtaining the @item{lighter}, search the remaining marked ruins and recover the other six Stelae.
Confirm that all ten Stelae have been returned rather than stopping when the initial four-piece objective completes.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Complete all @item{six Gizeh mysteries}, from Seat of Eternity through A Thief’s Promise.

guide.context: Every required Mystery can be finished during Gizeh free roam or through Revisit after the story.

steps.text: Resolve the Gizeh cases @mechanic{Seat of Eternity} and @mechanic{Fortune’s Reach}, followed by @mechanic{Bright Future}.
Finish @mechanic{The Haunting}; then close @mechanic{Cloud Atlas} and the final investigation, @mechanic{A Thief’s Promise}.
Open the Gizeh Journal page and confirm that all six Mystery entries are complete.

achievements.description: Solve the Cogwheel puzzle in Sukhothai.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Solve all @item{six Sukhothai cogwheel puzzles} and take the Ancient Relic from every solved chamber.

guide.context: After the Hidden Pyramid, Tongdang sells @item{Sukhothai Cogwheels} for 700 baht; this guide marks all six chambers. Ten loose Small Cogwheels are reused across the route.

steps.text: Return from the Hidden Pyramid, buy @item{Sukhothai Cogwheels} from @npc{Tongdang}, and recover the three Small Cogwheels found during the pyramid approach.
Follow the guide markers through @loc{Waterfall Ruins}, @loc{Village}, and @loc{Wat Mahathat}; solve each gear train, take its Ancient Relic, and remove every loose Small Cogwheel before leaving.
Continue through @loc{Wat Si Sawai}, @loc{Hidden Platform}, and @loc{River Bank}; connect each power gear to its relic mechanism and take the Ancient Relic from all three chambers.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Complete all @item{eight Sukhothai mysteries}, from Path of Tigers through The Serpent’s Chest.

guide.context: All eight investigations remain available in Sukhothai free roam after the local story is complete.

steps.text: Resolve @mechanic{Path of Tigers} and @mechanic{Monkey Business}; then finish the Sukhothai cases @mechanic{Child’s Play} and @mechanic{Elephant in the Room}.
Close @mechanic{A Game of Wits} and @mechanic{Counting Letters}; then resolve @mechanic{Timely Arrival} plus @mechanic{The Serpent’s Chest}.
Open the Sukhothai Journal page and confirm that all eight Mystery entries are complete.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Defeat all @enemy{nine boxing champions}: three each in the Vatican, Gizeh, and Sukhothai underground rings.

guide.context: Each arena admits Indy only in its regional uniform: Blackshirt in the Vatican, Wehrmacht in Gizeh, and Royal Army in Sukhothai.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Blackshirt disguise}, enter the Vatican boxing ring, and defeat its three champions.
Equip the @item{Wehrmacht disguise}, enter the Gizeh boxing ring, and defeat its three champions.
Equip the @item{Royal Army disguise}, enter the Sukhothai boxing ring, and defeat its three champions.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Collect the complete @item{50 Ancient Relics}: Vatican 10, Gizeh 15, Sukhothai 24, and Iraq one.

guide.context: Six Sukhothai relics sit behind the cogwheel puzzles. The complete set also opens the Secret Vault material needed for Archivist.

steps.text: Collect all @item{10 Vatican Ancient Relics} and all @item{15 Gizeh Ancient Relics}.
Collect all @item{24 Sukhothai Ancient Relics}, including the six taken from cogwheel chambers.
Collect the final @item{Ancient Relic} in @loc{Iraq}, and keep the full set together for the Secret Vault puzzle.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Add any @item{50 valid entries} to the Journal through notes, photographs, Fieldwork, Discoveries, or Mysteries.

guide.context: Journal progress accumulates naturally across story missions and optional exploration; photographs count alongside written notes.

steps.text: Open the Journal in each region and pursue nearby Fieldwork, Mystery, Discovery, and photograph markers.
Collect or complete entries until the Journal total reaches 50.

achievements.description: Collect all Journal notes in the game.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Collect every @item{base-game Journal entry}, including hint photographs and the Secret Vault entries tied to all 50 Ancient Relics.

guide.context: Journal registration can fail even when map categories look complete. Hint photos count, and required story-area entries normally relocate to revisitable hubs.

steps.text: Before traveling to Iraq, photograph @npc{Sunan fishing} and take every available hint photograph, including the Fountain of Confession and Sacred Wounds Mural hints.
Clear every Adventure, Fieldwork, Discovery, and Mystery entry in each base-game region, waiting for the hat-shaped save icon after every pickup.
Collect all @item{50 Ancient Relics} and solve the @mechanic{Secret Vault} puzzle for its final Journal entries.
If a newly collected entry does not increase the Journal total, use @mechanic{Save Rollback} before making further progress and collect that entry again.

achievements.description: Clobber an enemy with a guitar.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Pick up a @item{guitar} in an enemy area and strike an enemy with the guitar once.

guide.context: Guitars are improvised weapons and may break on the first impact. Enemy barracks and the Nazi Recreational Area in Gizeh provide reliable opportunities.

steps.text: Look for a @item{guitar} inside an occupied barracks or at the @loc{Gizeh Nazi Recreational Area}.
Pick up the guitar, approach any conscious enemy, and use the melee attack to hit that enemy.

achievements.description: Hit an enemy with a fly swatter.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Pick up a @item{fly swatter} and hit any enemy with the fly swatter once.

guide.context: A reliable fly swatter rests on a crate beside the spotlight outside the Capitano office in Castel Sant’Angelo.

steps.text: Travel to @loc{Castel Sant’Angelo} and approach the office labeled @loc{Capitano} on the map.
Take the @item{fly swatter} from the crate beside the nearby spotlight.
Carry the fly swatter to a conscious enemy and use the melee attack once.

achievements.description: Hit an enemy with an apple.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Select an @item{apple} from the fruit quick slot and throw the apple into any enemy.

guide.context: Apples appear in Marshall College and the Vatican. The quick slot favors recently collected fruit, so other fruit may have to be eaten or discarded first.

steps.text: Pick up an @item{apple} in @loc{Marshall College} or @loc{the Vatican}.
Open the fruit quick slot and eat or discard other stored fruit until the apple is held.
Aim at a conscious enemy and throw the apple so that it strikes the target.

achievements.description: Push an enemy off a ledge.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Use the shove action to push an enemy completely off a cliff, wall, roof, or watchtower ledge.

guide.context: Watchtower guards are convenient because their platforms have exposed edges and enough height to register the fall.

steps.text: Approach an enemy standing near an exposed ledge, or lure an enemy toward the edge during combat.
Face the enemy toward the drop and use the shove action until the enemy falls completely from the ledge.

achievements.description: Disarm an enemy with your whip and then use his weapon to knock him out.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Disarm an armed enemy with the @item{whip}, pick up that enemy’s dropped weapon, and knock out the same enemy with it.

guide.context: A light enemy blocks less and falls before most improvised weapons break. The Sleight of Hand ability is helpful but not required.

steps.text: Find a lightly armored enemy holding a melee weapon and leave that enemy conscious.
Use the @item{whip} to force the enemy to drop the weapon.
Pick up the dropped weapon and attack the same enemy until the knockout registers.

achievements.description: Knock out an enemy using only counters.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Knock out one enemy using only timed blocks followed by counterpunches, without landing any normal attack.

guide.context: A counter registers when Indy blocks immediately before a punch and answers with one punch. Extra attacks invalidate the counter-only attempt.

steps.text: Engage one ordinary unarmed enemy without striking first.
Block immediately before each incoming punch, deliver exactly one counterpunch, and return to blocking.
Continue the block-and-single-counter sequence until that enemy is knocked out.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Dodge sideways or backward as a @enemy{Heavyweight} performs a telegraphed two-handed power punch.

guide.context: Heavyweights signal the required attack by clasping both hands before swinging; ordinary punches do not count.

steps.text: Engage a large @enemy{Heavyweight} and keep enough space to see the attack animation.
Wait until the Heavyweight brings both hands together for the power punch.
Move sideways or backward and press dodge before the two-handed strike lands.

achievements.sortReason: Complete while clearing the optional Fieldwork in the Vatican.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{The Mad Priest} Fieldwork mission in @loc{the Vatican}.

guide.context: Catherine’s Letter begins the mission, and the Clerical Key is required to reach Sister Catherine in the Sistine Chapel. Antonio supplies the Sewers Key after Catherine explains the missing diary.

steps.text: Take @item{Catherine’s Letter} from the desk outside Ernesto’s room in the @loc{Vatican Post Office}, then use the Clerical Key to meet @npc{Sister Catherine} in the Sistine Chapel.
Talk to @npc{Antonio} in the Apostolic Library, receive the @item{Sewers Key}, and enter the sewers beneath the @loc{Tower of Nicholas V}.
Cross the flooded round chamber into the restricted Apostolic Palace room and take @item{Crescenzo’s Diary} from its guarded footlocker.
Return Crescenzo’s Diary to @npc{Sister Catherine} in the Sistine Chapel to complete @mechanic{The Mad Priest}.

achievements.sortReason: Complete while clearing the optional Fieldwork in the Vatican.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{A Savage Discovery} Fieldwork mission in @loc{the Vatican}.

guide.context: Either the Theft Report outside the Apostolic Library or Professor Savage in the Borgia Courtyards can start the mission. Sidney’s rescue reveals the route to the stolen fragment.

steps.text: Read the @item{Theft Report} in the tent outside the Apostolic Library or speak to @npc{Professor Savage} in the Borgia Courtyards.
In the Vatican Gardens security barracks, take the @item{Jail Cell Key} from the south-wall hook, unlock Sidney’s cell, and speak to @npc{Sidney}.
Enter section F of the excavation, defeat @enemy{Giuseppe}, and take the @item{Cellar Key} from his body.
Unlock the basement from the ramp along the Post Office’s eastern wall, recover the @item{stone fragment}, and deliver it to Professor Savage and Sidney in the library.

achievements.sortReason: Complete while clearing the optional Fieldwork in the Vatican.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{A Nun in Trouble} Fieldwork mission in @loc{the Vatican}.

guide.context: Antonio’s examination of the Warrior Giant’s Parchment triggers this assignment automatically. Gina waits in the Sistine Chapel and opens the locked museum routes.

steps.text: Once the Warrior Giant’s Parchment scene with Antonio ends, meet @npc{Gina} in the Sistine Chapel and follow her through the museum wing.
In the museum stockroom, examine the @item{Handprint}, @item{Gina’s Note}, @item{Piece of Cloth}, @item{Identification Card}, and @item{Castello Photograph}.
Follow the footprints, blood trail, and @item{Giuliana’s ring}, then travel with Gina to @loc{Borgia Tower} through the Apostolic Palace.
Climb Borgia Tower, defeat the guards in the top interrogation room, and free @npc{Giuliana} to finish the Fieldwork.

achievements.description: Complete “Secret of the Queen Mother” Fieldwork.
achievements.sortReason: Complete while clearing the optional Fieldwork in Gizeh.
achievements.summary: Finish the @loc{Gizeh} assignment named @mechanic{Secret of the Queen Mother}.

guide.context: Omar waits outside the Khentkawes Dig. The tomb elevator needs power from two separate branches before floor -1 becomes accessible.

steps.text: Speak to @npc{Omar} outside the @loc{Khentkawes Dig}, enter the excavation, and descend to the disabled central elevator.
Follow the west and north passages from the elevator and activate both power switches, then ride the elevator to floor @mechanic{-1}.
In the mural chamber, place the @item{eagle stone} in the top slot, the @item{snake stone} in the middle, and the @item{fish stone} in the bottom.
Use the nearby sledgehammer on the illuminated weak wall, take the @item{Stele} from the hidden chamber, and return to Omar.

achievements.sortReason: Complete while clearing the optional Fieldwork in Gizeh.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Sanctuary of the Guardians} Fieldwork mission in @loc{Gizeh}.

guide.context: Gina starts the assignment by playing an intercepted message and handing over the Excavation Photograph. The Golden Medallion becomes available only after the Logbook Entry is read inside the Sphinx.

steps.text: After @npc{Gina} gives Indy the Excavation Photograph, enter the @loc{Sphinx dig} from the south and read the @item{Logbook Entry} beside Gina.
Take the @item{Golden Medallion} from the newly opened tent in the Nazi Recreational Area and insert it into the matching Sphinx door.
In the first mirror room, aim northeast to southwest, southeast to northwest, and northwest toward the dish beside the right stairs; then take the @item{Gold Mask}.
Break the scorpion room’s weak wall with the metal bar, burn the tunnel debris, and turn the next room’s statue toward the left dish.
Activate the opposite dish, boost Gina through the high gap, carry her loose mirror into the first room, and reflect Gina’s beam into the second dish to open the exit.
Cross the chasm with Gina’s light, crawl beneath the final gate, collect the @item{Protector Stele}, and use the switches beyond the scorpion pit to return to the excavation.

achievements.sortReason: Complete while clearing the optional Fieldwork in Gizeh.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{A Savage Predicament} Fieldwork mission in @loc{Gizeh}.

guide.context: This sequel to A Savage Discovery begins with Professor Savage in Gizeh Village. The detention-center notes move the search to the Mortuary Temple excavation.

steps.text: Speak to @npc{Professor Savage} in Gizeh Village, enter the Nazi detention center through the passage north of the Sebek Stele tomb, and read @item{Gantz’s Orders}.
At the Mortuary Temple excavation, read @item{Gantz’s Journal} in the mess hall and enter @loc{A1 Tunnel}.
Use the whip to lower Indy through the floor opening, find @npc{Sidney}, break the south wall with a metal rod, and escort Sidney west past the two Nazi bruisers and raised beam.
Return to Professor Savage in @loc{Gizeh Village} after Sidney reaches safety.

achievements.sortReason: Complete while clearing the optional Fieldwork in Sukhothai.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{The Kid Who Vanished} Fieldwork mission in @loc{Sukhothai}.

guide.context: Gina starts the assignment during a Sukhothai boat trip. The treehouse’s Hidden Map identifies Wat Si Sawai, where two water-routing puzzles block the route to Aran.

steps.text: After Gina reports the missing villager, dock near the marked treehouse, take @item{Aran’s Photograph}, and pry up the loose floorboard for the @item{Hidden Map}.
At @loc{Wat Si Sawai}, use the first pipe piece to open the north door, take the second piece, push the giant cogwheel assembly into the gears, and move the straight piece to the remaining slot.

Put the elbow piece in the four-way slot to send water toward the cogwheels and pull the lever to raise the first platform; at the bridge, face the T-piece north, straight piece west, and elbows north and south.
Meet @npc{Aran} at the Shiva Shrine, speak with him, then return to @npc{Sunan} in Khaimuk Saksit Village.

achievements.sortReason: Complete while clearing the optional Fieldwork in Sukhothai.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{A Study in Fear} Fieldwork mission in @loc{Sukhothai}.

guide.context: The assignment appears after Indy leaves the Hidden Pyramid. Pailin’s Demolition Request points to the blasted temple entrance southwest of the treehouse.

steps.text: Speak to @npc{Pailin}, read the @item{Demolition Request} on her desk, and follow the southwest excavation path through the blasted temple opening.

In the first trap room, insert the Circle key and remove it when the circle, diamond, and cross align; at the next pedestal, use the Circle key to align circle with cross, then the Cross & Circle key to align the diamond.

At the burial chamber’s east pedestal, use the Circle key to align circle with cross, then the Cross & Circle key to align that pair with the diamond and line; at the west pedestal, use the Cross & Circle key to align its two pairs.
At the south pedestal, use Cross & Diamond to align the diamond with the line, use Circle to align circle with cross, then use Cross & Circle to join both aligned pairs.
Insert all three keys into the central pillar, pull the revealed lever, recover the @item{Idol of Yaksha} after Annika’s fall, and give the idol to Pailin.

achievements.sortReason: Complete while clearing the optional Fieldwork in Sukhothai.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Lost in the Past} Fieldwork mission in @loc{Sukhothai}.

guide.context: Sunan’s demon story begins this assignment. The cave lies beyond the bulldozers at Wat Sa Si, through the crawlspace centered between two statues.

steps.text: Listen to @npc{Sunan} in Khaimuk Saksit Village, travel to @loc{Wat Sa Si}, crawl through the opening between the two statues, and activate the cave’s prayer wheel.
In the vision, place the @item{Staff of Ra headpiece} on the desk’s right spot, the fertility idol in the middle, and the cat mummy on the left.
At the Sacred Wounds mural, set both hands to 2, the side to 3, the left foot to 4, and the right foot to 3; later combine the X and I plates to open room XI.
Set the prayer wheel to @mechanic{Gira’ahn-matu}, @mechanic{Heh-zam-eesh}, and @mechanic{Heh’k-dashu}; take the Golden Fishing Hook and give it to Sunan.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Eat a @item{Cornetto} from the basket beside the window in @npc{Antonio’s Vatican office}.

guide.context: The pastries respawn in Antonio’s office, so the food remains available during later Vatican visits.

steps.text: Enter @npc{Antonio’s office} in @loc{the Vatican} and approach the table beside the window.
Take a @item{Cornetto} from the basket and use the eat action.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Find and eat one @item{Aish Baladi bread} in @loc{Gizeh}.

guide.context: Aish Baladi commonly spawns in the Workers’ Camp, Gizeh Village, enemy compounds, barracks, and whip-opened food boxes.

steps.text: Search food tables or whip-opened food boxes in @loc{Gizeh Workers’ Camp}, @loc{Gizeh Village}, or an enemy compound.
Pick up one @item{Aish Baladi bread} and use the eat action.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Find and eat one @item{Star Fruit} in @loc{Sukhothai}.

guide.context: Star Fruit commonly spawns in Khaimuk Saksit Village, Voss’s Camp, barracks, mess tents, and whip-opened food boxes.

steps.text: Search food tables or whip-opened food boxes in @loc{Khaimuk Saksit Village}, @loc{Voss’s Camp}, or another Sukhothai enemy camp.
Pick up one @item{Star Fruit} and use the eat action.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Open @mechanic{Journal > Travels}, select any previously visited major location, and hold the displayed Revisit command.

guide.context: Revisit becomes available after Indy reaches the Vatican and supports post-story cleanup without starting a new game.

steps.text: After reaching @loc{the Vatican}, open the @mechanic{Journal} and switch to the @mechanic{Travels} tab.
Select an unlocked major location and hold the on-screen @mechanic{Revisit} command until travel begins.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Capture @item{50 valid Journal photographs} by photographing subjects when the camera icon appears.

guide.context: A picture counts only when the subject frame and Journal prompt recognize it; story progress unlocks additional photo opportunities.

steps.text: Equip the camera whenever its icon appears in the upper-left corner.
Move and aim until the subject frame confirms the Journal subject, then take the photograph.
Continue across the regional hubs until 50 photographs have been added to the Journal.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Take @item{Ricci’s Casina Key} from Father Ricci’s office and use the key to enter @loc{Villa Pia’s Casina}.

guide.context: The Order of Giants starts beside the Fountain of Confession after the DLC is installed. The Casina key lies beneath the Research Note by the office’s north window.

steps.text: Meet @npc{Father Ricci} beside the @loc{Fountain of Confession} and follow the DLC objective into Ricci’s office.
At the north window, take the Research Note from the chest and pick up @item{Ricci’s Casina Key} beneath it.
Ride the zipline into the Casina grounds and unlock the Casina door with Ricci’s Casina Key.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Junia’s Tomb} and leave the sewers during The Order of Giants to reach Rome.

guide.context: This is an automatic DLC story unlock. The route into Rome is linear once Junia’s Tomb has been completed.

steps.text: Continue @mechanic{The Order of Giants} through @loc{Junia’s Tomb}.
Follow the story route through the sewers and exit into @loc{Rome} to trigger the achievement.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{The Order of Giants} DLC story, including the final @enemy{Abgal} encounter.

guide.context: No difficulty setting is required. After the ending, Rome remains available through fast travel even though the original manhole entrance closes.

steps.text: Advance every objective in @mechanic{The Order of Giants} until the final confrontation with @enemy{Abgal}.
Finish the Abgal encounter and the DLC mission’s closing sequence.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Collect any @item{25 Rome Journal notes} from DLC notes, photographs, mysteries, or Mithraic Artifact entries.

guide.context: The DLC contains 118 qualifying entries, so this milestone arrives well before Roman Scholar during a thorough story route.

steps.text: Photograph marked subjects and collect visible Adventure, Discovery, and Mystery notes while progressing through Rome.
Continue until the Rome Journal count reaches 25.

achievements.description: Collect all Journal notes in Rome
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Collect all @item{118 Rome Journal notes}: 60 Adventure, 45 Discovery, six Mystery, and seven Mithraic Artifact entries.

guide.context: The Rome Guide can mark missing DLC photos and notes, including entries back in the Vatican. Its lowered-Journal Door icon leads toward the necessary region transfer.

steps.text: Collect all @item{60 Adventure Notes}, all @item{45 Discovery Notes}, and all @item{six Mystery Notes} across the DLC route.
Collect all @item{seven Mithraic Artifacts} to add their seven Journal entries.
Use the @item{Rome Guide} in lowered-Journal mode to follow remaining markers; follow a Door icon back toward the Vatican when shown.
After the story, use fast travel to re-enter @loc{Rome}, because the original manhole entrance no longer works.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Collect any one @item{Mithraic Artifact} during The Order of Giants.

guide.context: Seven artifacts exist, and each one also adds a Journal entry toward Roman Scholar.

steps.text: Explore a marked Rome collectible site and recover one @item{Mithraic Artifact}.
Wait for the artifact’s Journal entry to register.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Collect all @item{seven Mithraic Artifacts} in The Order of Giants.

guide.context: Every artifact awards a separate Journal entry, so this set contributes seven of Roman Scholar’s 118 entries.

steps.text: Use the Rome collectible route or guide markers to locate each @item{Mithraic Artifact}.
Recover all seven artifacts and confirm that seven artifact entries appear in the Rome Journal.

achievements.description: Learn all abilities from Adventure books in Rome
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Find @item{Hard Crust} and @item{Vitamins} in Rome, then spend 1,000 Adventure Points to learn each ability.

guide.context: The achievement checks learned abilities, not book pickups. Both books cost 1,000 Adventure Points after collection.

steps.text: In the Casina Mediterranean mural room, open the hidden panel and collect the @item{Hard Crust} Adventure Book.
In Via Giulia, climb the scaffolding north of @loc{Libreria degli Artisti}, cross the balconies and plank walkway, and collect @item{Vitamins} in the upper room.
Open the @mechanic{Books} menu and spend 1,000 Adventure Points on Hard Crust and 1,000 on Vitamins.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Complete all @item{three Rome mysteries}: A Collegial Mystery, A Tale of Wine Making, and A Bull in the Sky.

guide.context: Each Rome Mystery starts from a different DLC sub-area: Casina Pio IV, a locked basement reached through Cloaca Maxima, and a hidden room inside the Mithraeum.

steps.text: For @mechanic{A Collegial Mystery}, take the north stairs in Casina Pio IV to the council chamber, read Federico’s and Allesandro’s letters, enter @mechanic{1222} in the northwest safe, and collect its contents.

For @mechanic{A Tale of Wine Making}, travel east from the Cloaca Maxima dock nearest Father Ricci’s basement, ignore the first grated branch, take the southeast tunnel at the next split, and break the wall beside the lit dock with a sledgehammer.
Place the mural tiles from left to right as Plant, Grow, Harvest, Process, Ferment, and Drink; then collect the @item{Perses Artifact}.
For @mechanic{A Bull in the Sky}, take the Mithraeum Key from the mess-hall desk drawer, unlock the east door, follow the south hall, and pull the lever inside the carved face’s mouth.
Numbering the seven floor platforms from left to right, place the weights as @mechanic{2, empty, 3, 2, empty, 1, 1}; collect the @item{Nymphus Artifact} when the Taurus panel opens.

achievements.description: Pet the cat at Via Giulia in Rome
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended regional cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Reach the upper Via Giulia room beside @loc{Libreria degli Artisti} and pet the cat next to the Vitamins book.

guide.context: The cat shares a room with the DLC’s Vitamins Adventure Book, so both achievements can be completed on the same visit.

steps.text: In @loc{Via Giulia}, find @loc{Libreria degli Artisti} and climb the scaffolding immediately north of the shop.
Use the balcony route and plank walkway to enter the upper room containing the @item{Vitamins} Adventure Book.
Approach the cat inside that room and use the pet interaction.
